correctness.rationale: For F_n x_i=maj(x_{i-1},x_{i-2},x_{i-3}) with n>=5, direct index calculation gives F=S^2 M for centered majority M, and M commutes with S. The wall count under M cannot increase, so periodic words are precisely no-isolated-color words (M-fixed) and, for even n, the two alternating words (M-interchanged). On the first class F is S^2; their fixed states under F^k repeat a word of length gcd(n,2k), counted by the four-state transfer matrix with characteristic polynomial (z^2-z-1)(z^2-z+1). The alternating pair contributes only for even k, and Mobius inversion counts primitive temporal cycles. A two-zero-block word has spatial period n, hence temporal n/gcd(n,2); alternating contributes two. Their LCM yields the stated group order and proves n is absent as an individual period for n=2 mod4. Independent full functional-graph enumeration for n=6,10 reproduced recurrent populations 22,124 and exact actual period sets, supporting but not replacing the all-n proof.
